description: A new submitting state leaves a failed checkout disabled without failure-path tests.
requirements: Disable checkout submission while an order is being sent. If it fails, show the error and let the user retry; verify both success and failure recovery.

expected.summary: On rejection submitting remains true, so submitDisabled prevents the promised retry. Users cannot recover from a temporary order error.
The new submitting state and failure recovery have no executable failure-path assertion. The only test covers success and cannot detect the permanently disabled retry button.
